profile.headline: Information Technology Manager 1 at Ohio Department of Job and Family Services
profile.summary:
ASP.NET – C# – VISUAL BASIC.NET – DEVEXPRESS – SQL – JAVASCRIPT– HTML – CSS

•	Worked on several large websites like www.standingcomfort.com, www.drewshoe.com, www.efohca.org, www.kahcf.org, www.methodisteldercare.org, www.brunercorp.com, and www.sycamore-associates.com; sites were built on a Windows platform utilizing ASP.NET, C#, Visual Basic.NET, DevExpress, and SQL Server 2008

•	Participated in development of a content management system (CMS) and a customer relations management system (CRM) that is the foundation of many Websites authored by Robin Technologies; systems are Web-based and were built on a Windows platform

•	Developed ecommerce solutions on Windows-based systems such as shopping carts, checkouts, and integrated payments using PayPal, Authorize.Net, and First Data Global Gateway APIs

•	Experienced in using ASP.NET forms to capture user input to store in SQL Server 2008 databases and retrieving that  data using SQL Stored Procedures and SQL Queries for output on Webpages, emails, excel sheets, and documents

•	Experienced in developing Windows Forms Applications such a software installer used by New Horizons Unlimited

company.name: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services

positions.title: Software Development Specialist 4
positions.description:
• Passed an 8-hour coding project to proceed to the interview phase and was selected for the only level 4 position posted.
• Assigned to the Driver’s License (DL) rewrite team. The new DL application will manage all driver’s licenses for the State of Ohio. The application is being built using C#, ASP.NET MVC 5.2.6, Bootstrap 3, jQuery, Web API, and Entity Framework 6.2.0, and is hosted on a 3-tier platform.
• Completed critical tasks on the DL rewrite project such as: court file processing, nightly batch processing, and the reporting database migration.  
• Serves as technical lead, performs impact analyses to identify interdependencies, assists with design reviews, and performs code reviews.

positions.title: Software Development Specialist 3
positions.description:
• Passed an 8-hour coding project to proceed to the interview phase.
• Completed the Ohio State Highway Patrol – Supplemental Life Insurance application. The system was built using C#, ASP.NET MVC 5.2.6, Bootstrap 3, jQuery, Web API, and Entity Framework 6.2.0, and is hosted on a 3-tier platform.
• Direction as Team Lead resulted in zero defects being discovered during the initial round of testing.
• Completed Azure training and developed a cloud-based application as a proof of concept for management.

company.name: Ohio Department of Rehabilitation and Correction (ODRC)

positions.title: Software Development Specialist 3
positions.description:
• Maintained the Department Offender Tracking System (DOTS), the agency’s primary software application. The DOTS Poral has over 11,000 active users with up to 5,000 being active during business hours.
• Worked with business area personnel to assure requirements are thoroughly defined and approved.
• Served as technical lead, performed impact analyses to identify interdependencies, assisted with design reviews, and performed code reviews
• Created detailed test designs and test plans, reviewed test data for performing test scenarios, coordinated execution of unit and system testing, and coordinated debugging efforts and defect tracking.

positions.title: Software Development Specialist 2
positions.description:
• Worked with business owners to identify system software requirements.
• Developed new web applications using ASP.NET, C#, Visual Basic, and SQL Server 2005 - SQL Server 2014.
• Defined problems, identified alternate courses of action, and implemented solutions based on latest technologies.
• Assisted in the review and evaluation of software development methodologies, user acceptance testing and software implementation tasks.

positions.title: Software Development Specialist 1
positions.description:
• Conducted system analysis and design by gathering system requirements, identifying future business process flows, and designing software solutions to meet business needs.
• Developed new web applications using ASP.NET, C#, Visual Basic, SQL Server versions 2005, 2008, and 2012.
• Wrote documentation such as application related training materials, software user-guides, systems development lifecycle activities, use cases, and technical installation guides.
• Wrote, executed, and verified unit test scripts for unit and systems testing.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Develops new web applications using ASP.NET, C#, Visual Basic, and SQL Server 2008
•	Tests and debugs existing applications  with Visual Studio 2008
•	Assists in administration of over 250 websites hosted on Windows Server 2003 and Windows Server 2008
•	Participates in project planning and development based on Agile software development methodologies
•	Enhances company systems for employee and customer management using ASP.NET and Visual Basic.NET
